physicalNotes: Radius 0.912 +/- 0.007 solar radii from Baştürk et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..714B/abstract): 634,478 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.899 +/- 0.033 solar masses from Baştürk et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-4 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025MNRAS.541..714B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5400 +/- 90 K from Bouma et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of WASP-4 b's parameter set from Bouma et al. 2019 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..217B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
